verdict.text: The reviewer concluded that the iPhone 17 Pro Max is a great device with impressive performance, camera, and design, but criticized the price. The audience is generally positive about the device, with 38% of comments being positive and 26% being negative.

brand_health_words.text: Of 100 comments, 38 read positive, 36 neutral and 26 negative.

audience_words.text: 100 comments were read; the comments are balanced.

agreement_words.text: There is no clear difference between the reviewer and the audience's opinions on the device's performance, camera, and design.

takeaways.text: The brand should highlight the improved thermal performance of the iPhone 17 Pro and Pro Max.
The brand should consider reducing the price of the iPhone 17 Pro Max to make it more competitive.
The brand should emphasize the features of the iPhone 17 Pro Max's cameras, such as the 48-megapixel main shooter and support for Apple Log 2.

moment_notes.text: The words read negative as the reviewer criticizes Apple's accessories, while the face reads positive and the voice reads positive.
The words read neutral as the reviewer discusses the ambient light sensors, while the face reads negative and the voice reads positive.
The words read negative as the reviewer criticizes the display's maximum refresh rate, while the face reads negative and the voice reads positive.
